summary: Tanzania Immigration's visa guidelines say a visa can be obtained online through its official website, which they recommend, or on arrival at an official entry point; the ordinary visa costs 50 USD, and US passport holders must apply for the multiple visa, which costs 100 USD. They say nationals of EAC member states, of SADC member countries except Comoro and of Commonwealth countries except the United Kingdom, Canada, Nigeria, India, Pakistan, Australia and New Zealand are not required to apply for a visa. The UK Foreign Office says all visitors to mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar, except residents, must have mandatory Tanzanian Government-provided inbound travel insurance, even if they already have a personal policy in place.

tips.text: The UK Foreign Office says all visitors except residents must have mandatory Tanzanian Government-provided inbound travel insurance, even if they already have a personal policy in place, valid for the duration of the stay (up to 92 days). You only need to buy it for your first port of entry, on arrival or online beforehand: from the National Insurance Corporation if you arrive in mainland Tanzania first, or from the Zanzibar Insurance Corporation if you intend to arrive in Zanzibar first. The Zanzibar Insurance Corporation says its policy costs US $44 per visitor.

Tanzania's visa guidelines say American nationals are not entitled to the ordinary visa (50 USD) and must apply for the multiple visa (100 USD), which may be issued for a maximum validity of twelve months.

Tanzania's visa guidelines say a visa can also be obtained on arrival at an official entry point, but recommend the online application, made only through the official Tanzania Immigration Services website and not through any other online links.

The UK Foreign Office says plastic bags are banned in Tanzania and that if you arrive by air you'll be asked to hand over all plastic bags; the ban does not include zip-lock bags for airline security procedures.
Uganda's Directorate of Citizenship and Immigration Control says the East African Tourist Visa allows the traveller to travel to Uganda, Kenya and Rwanda only.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Tanzania?
faq.answer: Tanzania Immigration's visa guidelines say nationals of EAC member states, of SADC member countries except Comoro and of Commonwealth countries except the United Kingdom, Canada, Nigeria, India, Pakistan, Australia and New Zealand are not required to apply for a visa. Other visitors coming for tourism must apply for the ordinary visa (50 USD), online or on arrival at an official entry point, except US passport holders, who must apply for the multiple visa (100 USD).

faq.question: Does the Tanzanian visa cover Zanzibar?
faq.answer: Yes. Tanzania's visa guidelines say a visitor to both Tanzania Mainland and Zanzibar selects the first destination on the form and is allowed to visit both places without a new visa. The UK Foreign Office says all visitors except residents must have mandatory Tanzanian Government-provided inbound travel insurance and only need to buy it for their first port of entry: from the Zanzibar Insurance Corporation if they intend to arrive in Zanzibar first, or from the National Insurance Corporation if they arrive in mainland Tanzania first. The Zanzibar Insurance Corporation says its policy costs US $44 per visitor.

faq.question: Can I get a Tanzanian visa on arrival?
faq.answer: Tanzania's visa guidelines list the countries whose nationals are eligible for both the online and the on-arrival visa. Nationals of the countries on their no-visa-on-arrival list (among them Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Iran, Pakistan, Somalia and Syria) cannot obtain a visa on arrival unless they have special permission from the Commissioner General of Immigration, and stateless persons and refugees must obtain a visa in advance. The guidelines recommend the online application.

faq.question: Why do US citizens pay more for a Tanzanian visa?
faq.answer: Tanzania's visa guidelines say that, due to bilateral agreements between Tanzania and America, American nationals are not entitled to the ordinary visa, so US passport holders who wish to visit for tourism or holiday must apply for the multiple visa (100 USD) even if they plan a single entry. It may be issued for a maximum validity of twelve months.

faq.question: Do I need a yellow fever certificate for Tanzania?
faq.answer: WHO lists Tanzania as requiring proof of yellow fever vaccination from travellers aged 1 year or over arriving from countries at risk of yellow fever transmission, including travellers who transited more than 12 hours through the airport of such a country.

faq.question: Is the East Africa Tourist Visa valid for Tanzania?
faq.answer: No. Uganda's Directorate of Citizenship and Immigration Control says the East African Tourist Visa allows the traveller to travel to Uganda, Kenya and Rwanda only.

summary.text: There are two options available for obtaining Tanzania Visa. The first option is obtaining Visa by applying online through Tanzania Immigration Services official website (www.immigration.go.tz) ; and the second option is obtaining Visa on arrival at official entry point. The fee for Ordinary Visa is 50 USD and has a validity of up to 90 days;
All visitors wishing to come for tourism purposes are required to apply for an Ordinary Visa EXCEPT American nationals (USA Passport holders) who are required to apply for Multiple Visa;
The fee for Multiple Visa is 100 USD and has a validity of 1 year.

entryRequirements.travelInsurance.text: All visitors to mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar, except residents, must have mandatory Tanzanian Government-provided inbound travel insurance, even if they already have a personal policy in place. You can buy insurance either online, or at ports of entry upon arrival in both mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar. This insurance is valid for the duration of your stay (up to 92 days).
You only need to buy insurance for your first port of entry, either mainland Tanzania or Zanzibar. You may be refused entry if you do not have the required insurance.

If you arrive in mainland Tanzania first, you must buy travel insurance from the National Insurance Corporation (NIC) upon arrival. This can also be purchased online beforehand via National Insurance Corporation.
If you intend to arrive in Zanzibar first, you must buy travel insurance from the Zanzibar Insurance Corporation (ZIC) upon arrival. This can also be purchased online beforehand via visit Zanzibar.
Travellers who purchased travel insurance from ZIC before 1 October may use it where the mainland is their first port of entry, and do not need to purchase travel insurance from NIC.

entryRequirements.onwardTicket.text: Visitors MUST show their Return Ticket upon arrival (at the entry point) in Tanzania;

entryRequirements.declarations.mainland-.text: All visitors to mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar, except residents, must have mandatory Tanzanian Government-provided inbound travel insurance, even if they already have a personal policy in place.

This insurance is valid for the duration of your stay (up to 92 days).
Travellers who purchased travel insurance from ZIC before 1 October may use it where the mainland is their first port of entry, and do not need to purchase travel insurance from NIC.
You may be refused entry if you do not have the required insurance.

entryRequirements.declarations.zanzibar-.text: If you intend to arrive in Zanzibar first, you must buy travel insurance from the Zanzibar Insurance Corporation (ZIC) upon arrival. This can also be purchased online beforehand via visit Zanzibar.

entryRequirements.customs.currencyLimits.text: You must declare all currencies exceeding 10,000 U.S. dollars upon arrival and departure from Tanzania.

entryRequirements.customs.notes.0.text: Plastic bags are banned for environmental reasons. If you arrive by air you’ll be asked to hand over all plastic bags on arrival. The ban does not include ‘ziplock’ bags for airline security procedures.

entryRequirements.customs.notes.1.text: You must obtain a permit to import a drone into Tanzania.
Information on drone importation – Tanzanian Civil Aviation Authority

entryRequirements.customs.notes.2.text: Border officials have arrested foreigners for trying to take wildlife items, including horns and seashells, out of the country. It’s illegal to do this without a certified export permit from the Ministry of Natural Resources and Tourism.
Do not bring animal skin accessories into Tanzania as you risk questioning or detention when leaving the country.

countryFacts.safety.text: FCDO advises against all but essential travel to any area within 20km of the Tanzanian border with the Cabo Delgado province of Mozambique, due to attacks by groups linked with Islamic extremism.
In Dar es Salaam, tourists have been ‘express kidnapped’. This means they’ve been assaulted, robbed and forced with the threat of violence to withdraw cash from ATMs.
It is safest to arrange a taxi through a hotel or travel operator.

countryFacts.bestTimeToVisit.text: The length of rainy seasons can vary, but they generally run from: the end of March to May October to mid-December
On the mainland, the rainy season usually extends from March to May and then again from November to December.

visaTypes.evisa-multiple.feeNotes.text: American nationals are not entitled for Ordinary Visa; this implies that, USA passport holders who wish to visit Tanzania for tourism or holiday MUST apply for Multiple Visa even If they plan for single entry.
Visa applications will be processed within ten days save for Referral visa category.
The list of countries under the Referral Visa Category is available on the Immigration Service website (on the Visa Information Section).

visaTypes.visa-on-arrival.feeNotes.text: All visitors wishing to come for tourism purposes are required to apply for an Ordinary Visa EXCEPT American nationals (USA Passport holders) who are required to apply for Multiple Visa;
The fee for Ordinary Visa is 50 USD and has a validity of up to 90 days;

visaTypes.transit-visa.feeNotes.text: This Visa may be issued to foreign nationals who seeks to enter the country on transit to other countries.
It is issued for a period not exceeding seven days.
Visa applications will be processed within ten days save for Referral visa category.
The list of countries under the Referral Visa Category is available on the Immigration Service website (on the Visa Information Section).

visaTypes.evisa-ordinary.feeNotes.text: The fee for Ordinary Visa is 50 USD and has a validity of up to 90 days;
Visa applications will be processed within ten days save for Referral visa category.
The list of countries under the Referral Visa Category is available on the Immigration Service website (on the Visa Information Section).

entryRequirements.overstay.text: If you overstay your visa or permit you can be arrested, detained and fined before being deported.

levies.name: Airport service charge
levies.exemptions: Children under two and passengers embarking at an airport where they are in transit.
levies.text: Under the Airport Service Charge Act, a passenger embarking on an international flight pays an airport service charge equivalent to forty US dollars, in foreign convertible currency, before embarkation to a collection agent or revenue office.

source.name: Tax Revenue Appeals Board (Tanzania) — Airport Service Charge Act
source.instrument: Airport Service Charge Act, Cap. 365 R.E. 2019, s. 3(3)-(4), s. 4(1)

levies.name: Airport service charge (Zanzibar)
levies.exemptions: Children under two and passengers embarking at a port where they are in transit.
levies.text: The Zanzibar Revenue Authority says passengers embarking an aircraft at any port in Zanzibar for a destination outside the country pay an airport service charge of USD 40, a debt due to the Government payable before embarkation.

source.name: Zanzibar Revenue Authority — Airport service charge

levies.name: Airport safety fee (Zanzibar)
levies.text: The Zanzibar Revenue Authority lists a safety fee of USD 9 alongside the airport service charge for passengers embarking an aircraft in Zanzibar.

source.name: Zanzibar Revenue Authority — Airport service charge

levies.name: Seaport service charge (Zanzibar)
levies.text: The Zanzibar Revenue Authority says passengers embarking a ship at any port in Zanzibar pay a seaport service charge that depends on the destination.

source.name: Zanzibar Revenue Authority — Seaport service charge

levies.feeText: USD 1 for foreign passengers travelling within Zanzibar, USD 2 to mainland Tanzania, USD 15 for travel outside the country.

levies.name: Infrastructure tax on hotel guests (Zanzibar)
levies.text: The Zanzibar Revenue Authority says guests staying in any hotel in Zanzibar pay an infrastructure tax of USD 1 to USD 5 per person per day depending on the hotel's star rating, and USD 10 per person per day for a room located under water.
